assets.title: Draped Mesh Drying Rack
assets.description: One original fixed fishing-net hanging rack appearance, counted together as one prop. Two thick end A frames have four complete flat feet and real open lower arches and upper triangular apertures. A broad long beam rests on both end frames, with one wide flat top and two full sloped shoulders. One continuous thick welded grid sheet crosses that beam and hangs down both sides in one U-shaped drape. Every grid aperture pierces the complete sheet thickness; the beam is visibly behind some supported top and shoulder apertures. The sheet has continuous reinforced perimeter strips and solid connected intersections, without separated crossing sticks. Full finite opposed beam-top and shoulder seats support the net, while its skirts stay clear of the end frames, ground and noncontact beam faces. All positions are fixed. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, horizontally centred ground datum. No textures, ropes or cloth simulation, labels, scene, old flat-net foot swap, landing-net bag conversion or perforated towel reuse. Static visual geometry only: no strength, tension, load, drying or fishing performance, weaving method, folding, manufacture, material suitability, stability, installation or safety claim. No compatibility claim with existing nets, racks or quay fixtures.
